posts.name: AgentKit by Scalekit
posts.tagline: MCP gateway for production agents that acts on your behalf
posts.description: Let your agents use 30,000+ tools across 600+ apps, from Salesforce to GitHub, through one MCP gateway. AgentKit handles auth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Give each agent only the tools its job needs with Virtual MCP Servers. Add internal APIs as custom connectors. Use Triggers to start an agent the moment an email lands. Built for developers taking agents to production: every call is logged. Free tier: 10,000 tool calls a month.

posts.name: Teamily AI
posts.tagline: Your personal agent, agent teams & people in one messenger
posts.description: The human-agent platform where people and always-on agents get work done together in one unified, context-aware space. Unlike single-user personal agents, Teamily AI enables multi-user, multi-agent teamwork. Built on an AI-native messenger, it connects people, agents, docs, meetings, calls, workflows, and business systems to automate office work and customer service. Agents become real teammates with persistent memory, proactive intelligence, and continuous self-improvement. Free to get started.

posts.name: Testifly
posts.tagline: Autonomous AI QA. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance.
posts.description: CTOs and founders with small teams and no time or resources to test and maintain. Connect your web app and Testifly does the rest. Discovers flows, writes tests, self-heals, explains failures with video. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance. 30-day free trial.

posts.name: Synter Canvas
posts.tagline: Your AI agent runs ads across 30+ ad platforms
posts.description: Your AI agent builds, launches and optimizes campaigns across 30+ ad platforms, with safety gates and guardrails on every change. $0.25 per verified write, 0% of ad spend.

posts.name: Videco
posts.tagline: Turn every video into a content campaign with AI
posts.description: Videco is an AI content studio and video hosting workspace for marketing teams. Find standout moments in demos and webinars, create branded short-form clips, and host, embed, and measure video in one place.

posts.name: Calendarly
posts.tagline: Your calendar and tasks, right on your iPhone Lock Screen
posts.description: Calendarly draws your calendar, reminders, Todoist tasks, notes and countdowns onto the iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper, and redraws it automatically through a Shortcuts automation.

posts.name: MachineMail
posts.tagline: Real inboxes for AI agents, with trust built in
posts.description: Give your AI agents real inboxes to receive and send emails. Connect them over MCP or API, use your own domain, and get a trust report on every inbound message. Free includes 3,000 messages/month; paid plans start at $9/month.

posts.name: LifeVal
posts.tagline: OpenAI's benchmark for everyday life tasks with AI
posts.description: LifeVal is OpenAI's new eval for the everyday tasks people most want help with, like finding childcare, budgeting, ordering groceries and government services. OpenAI says it used LifeVal for a year to push ChatGPT toward real agent work.

posts.name: Hookdeck Inspect
posts.tagline: Free webhook tester for you and your agent
posts.description: Test and debug webhooks with Hookdeck Inspect. Get a live URL you and your agent can use, plus mock webhooks for 500+ providers. It's free, no account or setup required.

posts.name: People Search by Context.dev
posts.tagline: People Search API: Find People by Role, Company & Location
posts.description: Describe the people you need in plain English. Get up to 10 profiles per call with role, employer, location, experience, skills, and schools.

posts.name: Wavefunction
posts.tagline: A minimal, open-source coding agent for your Mac
posts.description: Coding agents keep turning into super apps. Wavefunction goes the other way: a minimal desktop app built for coding. Keep chatting while it works on several tasks in parallel. Use your ChatGPT subscription, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter or a local model. Computer use runs on its own desktop, not yours. Free and open source.

posts.name: Prism
posts.tagline: Cursor for hardware engineering
posts.description: Prism is the AI platform for hardware engineering. CAD, physics solvers, 3D viewers, coding, and reporting together in one place, all driven by agents. Go from ideas to validated design effortlessly. Free to try on Windows, Mac and Linux.

posts.name: PowerShips
posts.tagline: Where battleships meets powers!
posts.description: Battleships with classes. Pick a class with an active ability and a passive, place your fleet and play a friend from a link or find an opponent online. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: Flockbay
posts.tagline: Free AI game maker built on Godot
posts.description: Flockbay is a free AI game maker built on Godot: an agent in the official Godot editor that writes GDScript and scenes, then playtests them. It runs the game, sends input events, reads the debugger and captures the viewport. Your game stays a plain Godot 4 project on disk. Start on free hosted AI, or bring your own Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, API key or MCP agent, or a local model on your GPU (Windows). Paid plans add Steam page drafts, trailers and devlogs. Godot 4.6+ on Windows, macOS, Linux.

posts.name: nana
posts.tagline: One terminal for every coding agent, on Windows
posts.description: Nana is a native terminal multiplexer for Windows. Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more side by side, each on its own git worktree. See who is working, waiting or done, review diffs, and keep agents running after you close the app. Free beta.

posts.name: Infino AI
posts.tagline: Search, vectors and SQL over one Parquet copy, for agents
posts.description: Infino is an open-source retrieval engine for AI agents. It keeps one copy of your data as Parquet on S3 or local disk, with BM25 and vector indexes inside the files. Agents run keyword, vector, hybrid and SQL search on it. Apache-2.0. Infino Cloud is generally available, with a free tier.

posts.name: Brink
posts.tagline: Turn your MacBook trackpad's edges into controls
posts.description: Brink is a free macOS menu bar app that turns your trackpad's edges into controls. Slide the right edge for volume, the left for brightness, the top for keyboard light. Swipe the bottom to skip, double-tap the corner to mute. Native HUD, haptic ticks.

posts.name: BRCKS Chat
posts.tagline: The chat app for building sites. Nothing gets lost.
posts.description: Every job gets its own chat for crews, subs and clients, with snags, bookings, video meetings and a client portal built in. Photos become snags, messages become a record. Subs and clients are free. Built by builders, for UK sites.

posts.name: IQ
posts.tagline: The dashboard for your team's AI use
posts.description: See usage, spend and every request in one place. Give each app or teammate its own key and limits. On Team, add budgets, alerts and an audit log. Built-in routing helps keep cost down. Plus IQ Code, our plugin for Claude Code. Free to start.

posts.name: kwant
posts.tagline: AI bots that check each other's work before saying "done"
posts.description: Open-source AI team for your Mac, Linux or VPS. Hire bots from 27 roles; each message goes to the bot that fits, and you see why. Bots split work into cards, hand off and test each other, and a task turns Verified only when kwant checks it. Web facts come with links that open at the exact quote. Bots earn autonomy in Flight School, but payments always ask, and you choose which sites each bot may open. Runs on the Claude, Codex or Grok you already pay for.

posts.name: One Roof
posts.tagline: A new way to build with agents. You stay in charge.
posts.description: One place for chorus coding: several sessions of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kimi and Antigravity working together, with you in charge. Real terminals, one Inbox for everything they ask you, and a morning page that says what happened overnight. Free and open source.

posts.name: Corvo
posts.tagline: A mailbox that tidies itself as mail arrives
posts.description: A new mailbox, not a layer over Gmail. Sign-in codes sit on the row with Copy, then archive themselves. Give each site its own address and pause it if it leaks. Trackers removed, scams called out. Agents draft under grants; nothing leaves without you.

posts.name: SUN Web & API
posts.tagline: Turn prompts and PDFs into audio, on the web or via API
posts.description: Meet the new SUN web experience and SUN API. Turn a prompt or PDF into podcasts, audio courses, audiobooks, stories, meditations, or music. Choose your voices, language, and length, explore public audio, and build audio generation into your own apps with the API.

posts.name: Beamfy
posts.tagline: AI vision assistant for blind people, live in 74 languages
posts.description: Beamfy is an AI vision assistant for blind and low-vision people. Tap once and it describes what is in front of you as you walk, speaking only what changes, hazards first, until you stop it. It reads printed text aloud, tells you what you are holding, finds a place by voice with walking directions, and SOS texts your emergency contact with your location. Built for VoiceOver and TalkBack, in 74 languages. Photos are not stored. Free to start on iPhone and Android.

posts.name: Scrawl
posts.tagline: Show your AI agent the problem with a visual frame
posts.description: Scrawl records your screen, voice, clicks and drawings, then packs them into one compact capture you paste into your AI coding agent. Press ⌥⇧S, talk, click and draw. Frames are taken only when something happens, speech is transcribed on your Mac, and each frame is cropped to where you worked. Works with iPhone mirroring and ScrawlKit for iOS apps. Open source (MIT). macOS 15+, Apple silicon.

posts.name: NEXUPIRA
posts.tagline: AI teammates that hand back finished work
posts.description: Hire an AI team, not another chat box. Every WhatsApp customer message gets a reply drafted from your own documents, Rex prepares quotes as PDFs, Docu turns receipts and statements into Excel, and Nova keeps your calendar. Set routines that run on schedule. Connect Google Workspace and Notion free; Slack, GitHub and Linear on Pro. Work with your AI team from ChatGPT or Claude (Pro). You approve what goes out. Free to start, Pro US$15/mo.

posts.name: MagicaLCore
posts.tagline: Six kinds of machine learning models, trained on your iPad
posts.description: MagicaLCore 2.0 goes from one model type to six: image, sound, tabular data, text, hand pose and hand action. Everything trains on the iPad's own chip, with no code, no Mac and no cloud. New in 2.0: pause a training and resume it later from History, test your model live with the camera or microphone, and a short explanation next to every setting. Export a standardmlmodel and drop it into Swift Playgrounds or Xcode. In 13 languages, plus an edition for schools.

posts.name: Remote Gaze
posts.tagline: Your Mac on your iPad and iPhone with no in-between server
posts.description: Remote Gaze puts your whole Mac on your iPad or iPhone at Retina resolution, up to 120fps, with touch, trackpad, keyboard and Apple Pencil. Nothing passes through anyone else's server: devices connect directly, end to end encrypted, with per-device keys in the Secure Enclave and Face ID gating. Gaze Host, the free Mac companion, gives a headless Mac mini a display of its own.

posts.name: Oreja de Van Gogh
posts.tagline: pause Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks
posts.description: A macOS menu bar app that pauses or lowers Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks, then returns it at the level and position you chose.

posts.name: VinSage
posts.tagline: Free used-car check in Chrome's side panel, US & CA
posts.description: VinSage sits beside any used-car listing in Chrome and shows NHTSA and Transport Canada recalls, crash ratings, owner complaints, fuel cost and a 0–100 deal score, plus a negotiation pack. Core checks are free. No account, no ads, no analytics.

posts.name: asklog
posts.tagline: Give your coding agents a boss. Answer it from your phone.
posts.description: Tell Chief one job. It splits it into tasks and starts Claude Code or Codex workers, each in its own copy of your repo, then brings you the decisions. Watch and answer from your phone, across your computers. Nothing merges without your authorization.

posts.name: Akema
posts.tagline: Read-only Kafka message inspection & analytics
posts.description: Watch the bus. Read-only Kafka message inspection and analytics: browse live topics, trap messages with CEL expressions and chart a window of traffic with DuckDB in the browser, without storing topic data. The stream, observed.

posts.name: EaseIn Health
posts.tagline: Track GLP-1 doses, symptoms and daily habits in one app
posts.description: Most GLP-1 apps stop at the dose. The hard part is everything in between: getting enough protein and water, handling nausea, keeping a routine. EaseIn tracks the whole journey & not just the injection: - Dose log with injection site rotation - Symptom log for nausea, fatigue & more - One daily card for protein, water, fibre, activity & sleep - Weekly Wrapped, a recap of your week - Dedicated Health coach for questions between appointments

posts.name: LidCommit
posts.tagline: Auto-commit when you close your laptop lid
posts.description: Never lose progress when you leave your desk. LidCommit is an autonomous Rust daemon with a sleek dark-mode desktop GUI that detects when your laptop lid closes, summarizes your diffs using Gemini, Ollama, or OpenAI, and pushes safely to GitHub with built-in secret scanning.

posts.name: HoldTalk
posts.tagline: Hold fn, speak, and the text appears in any Mac app
posts.description: HoldTalk is dictation for the Mac without a subscription. Hold the fn key, speak, and the text appears at the cursor in any app. Transcription runs on your Mac with Apple's speech engine, with a personal dictionary and a searchable history. 7 days of Pro free, then 2,000 free words a week or Pro once for 19 EUR during the launch.

posts.name: Peji
posts.tagline: An AI chat with a real browser you control
posts.description: The browser on your iPhone finishes the task. Ask for a price comparison, a flight, a PDF summary: Peji opens WebKit tabs, reads them, clicks and types, and keeps going until the job is done, with every step in the chat. It stops and waits for your tap before it sends, buys, pays or deletes. Chats, files and dictation stay on the phone. Answers that are a price list or a schedule come back as a table or a chart with the source links. Free on the App Store; Pro adds usage.

posts.name: Testera
posts.tagline: AI-driven API testing
posts.description: Free test management with hosted MCP for any AI client — Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, VS Code, or your own agents. Agentic Test Management on Advanced: triage CI failures, draft-PR self-heal, automations, and webhooks.

posts.name: Beaquaro Studio
posts.tagline: Write once, post everywhere. Your link in bio, too.
posts.description: Write in your own voice, post to your platforms, reply to comments, and share one link page with your portfolio, projects and bookable video calls. Free to start. Built by one person in the UK for creators who are tired of ten tabs.

posts.name: DocFit
posts.tagline: Docs PRs opened for you when your code merges
posts.description: DocFit is documentation CI for GitHub. When a code PR merges, it finds the affected documentation, write fixes, verifies it with build, lint and any custom commands, and then opens a docs PR for your team to review. It never merges on its own.

posts.name: Crossendor
posts.tagline: Ecommerce AI ad arbitrage: winning ads, empty markets
posts.description: Drop in any winning ad: image recognition finds the same product across 8 markets, shows who already sells it, and where nobody does yet. Plus daily-rated winning ads, top product keywords, brands scaling ads with shop traffic, and TikTok winners.

posts.name: Insight Hive
posts.tagline: See what works on Facebook. Publish smarter.
posts.description: Insight Hive helps Facebook publishers track competitor Pages, study their best-performing posts, publish across multiple Pages with automated first comments, and connect each post to real website traffic and earnings - all in one Facebook-first workflow.

posts.name: Sunlight
posts.tagline: The first camera-based infinite canvas window manager on Mac
posts.description: The first camera-based infinite canvas window manager for Mac. Free and open source.

posts.name: upcoach
posts.tagline: The coaching backend your AI runs on
posts.description: upcoach holds your coaching programs: curriculum, participants, events, payments and hosting. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client with OAuth, and your AI builds programs, posts to your programs and reads progress through upcoach's MCP server.

posts.name: Shuttio
posts.tagline: Switch CRMs without losing notes, files and links.
posts.description: Shuttio copies records, notes, tasks, files and lists from HubSpot, Pipedrive, Affinity, Attio or a CSV into a new CRM. You review every field, check a free 50-record sample, then run the rest. Into Attio it costs $0. Roll back removes what it created.

posts.name: Lume IQ
posts.tagline: A free IQ test with an honest score and no subscription
posts.description: A 30-question reasoning test (matrices, number series, mental rotation, odd-one-out) with questions generated on the spot, so nobody can memorize answers. Your score is free and comes with its margin of error, scored with item response theory. No subscription, no locked results.

posts.name: Caltunes
posts.tagline: Every song you play in Apple Music, saved on a calendar
posts.description: Apple Music's Recently Played only keeps your last few songs, so the track you loved last Tuesday is gone by Friday. Caltunes saves every song you play in Apple Music on a calendar. Open any day, see what played and play it again. Import years of history from Apple's privacy export, save albums and playlists, and get a music report every month. For anyone on Apple Music who's ever lost a song. On iPhone, iPad and Mac.

posts.name: Brief - Executive Intelligence
posts.tagline: Ensure what gets decided, gets done
posts.description: Brief is the Executive Intelligence platform. It tracks every decision you make and every commitment your team makes back, and catches what's slipping before the deadline does, so you walk into every conversation prepared.

posts.name: Pling
posts.tagline: A tiny Retro Game styled tally counter for your Mac menu bar
posts.description: Count anything from your Mac's menu bar. One click or one hotkey: the pixel digits flip, the coin chimes, the number goes up. Other habit apps want to coach you. Pling just wants to count. No account, no subscription, no streak to break. Free.

posts.name: SuppliFlex
posts.tagline: Real-time inventory and ops for product brands. No card.
posts.description: SuppliFlex is a real-time supply chain operations platform for US product brands doing $500K–$50M: inventory, orders, purchasing, fulfillment and accounting sync in one system of record. The sandbox is the real product on seeded data. Opens in under a minute, no card.

posts.name: Runner
posts.tagline: An AI growth team built from your code or POS sales
posts.description: Runner builds a growth team of AI agents from your code or your POS sales. Leaders keep it on your goal, a lead works each channel, and two advisors argue it out. AI credits included, or your own key. From $49 a month, 14-day money-back guarantee.

posts.name: Routin Challenges
posts.tagline: Pick a challenge. Bring your friends. Follow through.
posts.description: Turn a goal into a challenge you can take on alone or with friends. Create your own, set a timeframe, or join an existing challenge. Invite friends with a code, track your progress, earn points, and see where you stand on the leaderboard. From exercising more to changing a habit, give yourself a reason to keep going.

posts.name: HN Apps
posts.tagline: The iOS and Android apps Hacker News talks about, ranked
posts.description: Every iOS and Android app linked on Hacker News since 2009, about 6,500 still on a store. Ranked by HN score, with week, month and year lists, an HN mood for each app, and links to the threads that mentioned it. Free and open source.

posts.name: RevOS Metric Store
posts.tagline: One definition of every metric, for people and AI agents
posts.description: Ask four systems for ARR and you get four numbers. RevOS Metric Store gives every metric one definition, written as code in your semantic model. Dashboards, BI tools and AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT all read the same one. Now in beta.

posts.name: Nexion
posts.tagline: One native Mac window for you and your AI agents
posts.description: Nexion is a native macOS workspace for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and the rest: a real Ghostty terminal, browser, files, Git, worktrees and a canvas in one window, which your agents can drive too. Spaces, herdr and tmux sessions, a phone companion

posts.name: Gymscle
posts.tagline: Free workout tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch
posts.description: A native training tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch. Build structured plans, run them at the gym, track your progress. Free, no account, no subscription.

posts.name: Pulseboard
posts.tagline: Weekly marketing dashboards that tell you what to fix
posts.description: Pulseboard pulls data from every marketing channel (Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Ads, Google LSA, Google Business Profile, Meta Ads, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) and builds a branded weekly dashboard with AI recommendations. Two options: agencies white-label it for their clients ($149/mo founding), or business owners get a fully managed, turnkey setup ($499/mo + $500 one-time setup) where everything is done for them.

posts.name: Flux by Reportei
posts.tagline: Approve and schedule social posts 10x faster with AI
posts.description: Approve and schedule social posts 10x faster with AI. Flux AI writes captions and images, clients approve by link, and MCP schedules from Claude or ChatGPT.

posts.name: Porro
posts.tagline: Client site monitoring and updates for agency care plans
posts.description: Uptime, SSL, security advisories, end-of-life versions and update pull requests for every client site on your care plans, ranked so what needs you is always on top. Free, read-only connectors for Laravel, Filament, Statamic and Craft.

posts.name: SIFOR
posts.tagline: Discover people through interactive Snackables
posts.description: Discover people through interactive Snackables. Make your own and let the world discover you.

posts.name: Lil Floaty Cam
posts.tagline: Float your webcam cutout over any Mac app
posts.description: Lil Floaty Cam is a lightweight native Mac app that removes your webcam background in real time and floats you over any app, even in full screen. Click and interact with anything behind your floating camera without it getting in the way. Perfect for tutorials, demos, and streaming. Record your screen and camera together using your favorite screen recorder, with no compositing needed! Resize, reposition, and customize your camera, with automatic hiding and playful physics.

posts.name: DocSolved
posts.tagline: Documents in. Predictable data out. Ready in seconds.
posts.description: Turn documents and images into reliable, structured data with AI - at up to 10× lower cost than enterprise alternatives. Extract, verify, and review data from invoices, receipts, e-invoices, and more. Organize everything with workspaces and dossiers, collaborate and share securely with one click, protect sensitive information with automatic data masking. Connect AI agents instantly via MCP, integrate any system through APIs and webhooks, or export results in your preferred format.

posts.name: Nive: White Noise, Sleep Sound
posts.tagline: Sleep sounds that fade out instead of waking you up
posts.description: nive is a calm place made of sound. Layer up to 6 of 60+ seamless sounds (rain, forest, ocean, fire, brown noise) into your own mix and place each one left, right or all around you. Sleep Mode fades it gently to silence over 30 min to 8 h instead of cutting off, so the stop doesn't wake you. Chromecast any sound or mix to a speaker or TV, or just ask Alexa. Plus guided wind-down breathing, offline downloads, and no data collected.

posts.name: DearWriter
posts.tagline: Doodle a scene. Strangers and AI finish the story.
posts.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. Doodle a stick figure — DearWriter paints it into an illustration and writes the scene. Then a stranger doodles the next. Seven scenes later, you've co-written an illustrated story with people who can't draw either.

posts.name: Foresight AI
posts.tagline: Website strategy platform for marketers and agencies
posts.description: Know what to fix, in which order, and why. Foresight is an always-on website strategist for teams who own websites but aren’t website specialists. A free audit scores your site across 10 strategy dimensions. Connect GA4, Search Console, CRM and add sales calls to get an improvement roadmap, a new sitemap and an editable brand strategy. The platform tracks every change and reports weekly on how your site performs. Powered by AI, built on learnings from 300+ enterprise projects by Flow Ninja.

posts.name: AutoSubtitles
posts.tagline: Free AI subtitle generator for video
posts.description: Add subtitles to video in your browser. Auto subtitles and captions in seconds, with 28 caption styles.

posts.name: Streaks Strokes
posts.tagline: A rowing app for iPhone
posts.description: A rowing app for iPhone and Apple Watch that connects to your Concept2 PM5 over Bluetooth. It shows pace, stroke rate, power and heart-rate zones live, saves every row to Apple Health and keeps a streak of the days you row.

posts.name: PropKeeper
posts.tagline: Smart property management right in your pocket
posts.description: Rentals, payments, finances, and analytics — everything under control, right on your smartphone.

posts.name: Unrot
posts.tagline: Retrain your X For You feed in 14 days, one click at a time
posts.description: Unrot diagnoses your X For You feed for free (slop, rage bait, echo chambers), then gives you a $9, 14-day plan of manual mutes, follows and posts to read, plus a Chrome and Firefox extension that measures your junk share daily. It never touches your account.

posts.name: Sele Notları
posts.tagline: Explore motorcycle review notes backed by sources.
posts.description: Sele Notları turns motorcycle reviews on YouTube into searchable summaries and pros and cons using AI. Compare what different reviewers say, see where they agree or disagree, and jump to the relevant moments in the original videos. Free to use, available in English and Turkish.

posts.name: pr-risk-score
posts.tagline: Risk-score pull requests so only the risky ones need a human
posts.description: Paste a GitHub PR URL, get a 0-100 risk score and a decision: AI review is enough, or a human must look. A deterministic baseline (auth, migrations, CI, secrets, test gaps) plus a bounded Claude review, every point traced to file:line. Free and open source.

posts.name: Nuri
posts.tagline: A free day planner for iPhone
posts.description: Just say it. Nuri turns your thoughts into a calm visual day, breaks big things into tiny first steps, and re-plans when you fall behind. A free day planner for iPhone.

posts.name: ZeroCrew
posts.tagline: The AI agents founders run their business on
posts.description: ZeroCrew sets up AI agents that run your business and keeps them up to date. Get it done for you, starting at $1,000 a month, or browse the AI agents and tools ZeroCrew researched for every job and do it yourself. ZeroCrew AI Ltd also builds apps for the App Store: Flags Tax, Schengen Calculator, Visited Countries, GOAT To Do, and GOAT Habits.

posts.tagline: 170W Total Output—Ultimate Desktop Charging Solution
posts.description: - AOHi

posts.description: Tune your instrument. Find your rhythm. Tuneara pairs a clear, visual tuner for guitar, bass, ukulele and violin with a metronome for everyday practice. Free on iOS and Android, with no subscription or paid upgrade.

posts.name: Lumni
posts.tagline: Catch AI agent failures that look like success
posts.description: Your AI agent says the refund was issued, but the API call failed. Lumni detects silent failures in agent traces, pinpoints what went wrong, and helps teams investigate, replay incidents, and prevent regressions. Start by pasting a trace—no SDK required.

posts.name: ZikZak
posts.tagline: Turn your photos into a map of everywhere you've been
posts.description: See everywhere you've been, from your own photos. ZikZak reads the GPS in your photos (Google Photos Takeout too) and places them on a satellite world map. Replay trips on a timeline, share a link or video, and plan Someday trips. Private by default and free.

posts.name: SaaS TechStack Growth Simulator™

posts.description: Over the past 5 years building and advising venture-backed SaaS startups, I kept noticing the exact same fatal pattern: Founders obsess over CAC and pricing tiers, but completely ignore the silent killer draining their cash: Tool Sprawl & Operational Silos We created the SaaS TechStack Growth Simulator as a free, open diagnostic instrument for founders. It models the real engineering hours wasted, software burn, and AI velocity multipliers across 60+ global and MENA tools.

posts.name: QuickDraw
posts.tagline: Turn your trackpad into a magic wand 🪄
posts.description: Draw a letter with your track pad and open apps magically. Simply hold the Option Key (⌥), Draw & Boom: apps, websites, files, Shortcuts and snippets, all summoned in a stroke.

posts.name: SprintCo

posts.description: SprintCo is a lightweight daily work log for individuals and teams. No streaks, no gamification — just clear, focused daily progress.

Born from following one small plane, the Brasileirinho, around the world.

posts.tagline: AI Tools Directory with Demo Videos
posts.description: Browse hundreds of AI tools by category and watch a short demo video of each one before you try it. Compare tools, save favourites and pick faster.

posts.description: Turn messy travel research into a realistic 24-hour visual itinerary with built-in transit buffers, budget tracking, and 1-click PDF export.

posts.description: A downloadable AI video studio for your own AI agent: a video engine, 43 editable templates, edit styles for your own recordings, six agent skills, local voice and subtitles, music and sound. Make explainers, product demos, reels, thumbnails and posts, in your own brand and design system.

posts.name: noondesk
posts.tagline: Design Subscription for Marketing Teams
posts.description: A design subscription for marketing teams: a dedicated senior designer, a project manager, unlimited requests and one flat monthly price.

posts.name: Still Bureau
posts.tagline: Websites and client galleries, connected.
posts.description: Still Bureau connects a photography website, client galleries, proofing, download controls, and studio work. Start with a 14-day no-card trial, then keep the website-and-gallery workflow on Free within its published limits.

posts.name: Stackapella
posts.tagline: Learn harmony in your browser, free and open source
posts.description: Learn a harmony part from a guide voice while your notes light up, then record every part yourself, exactly in time. Runs in your browser: no app to install, no account to start. Free course from one note to four-part harmony. Open source.

posts.name: Phaze
posts.tagline: Remote desktop for companies
posts.description: Phaze gives people and their AI agents access to other computers. Ask Claude, Codex, or any LLM to connect to a machine and complete tasks or fix it. Artists and engineers connect to their 3D workstation from anywhere. IT connects instantly to troubleshoot.

posts.name: Opal Reader
posts.tagline: PDF and EPUB reader built for the first iPhone Duo
posts.description: Unfold your next chapter. Read PDFs and EPUBs, keep a notebook beside the page, and continue in a compact view on iPhone Duo. Also available on iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: Traced
posts.tagline: Automated Competitor Monitoring for Startups
posts.description: Traced is an automated competitor monitoring tool for SaaS teams. It checks competitors' public pricing, homepage, feature, and changelog pages every week and reports exactly what changed.

posts.name: HNMovies
posts.tagline: 2,280+ films & docs distilled from 20 years of Hacker News
posts.description: HNMovies distills 49.3M Hacker News comments (2007–present) into a ranked screening room of 2,281 feature films and standalone documentaries. Filters out technical collisions (Solaris, Threads, Primer) and meme one-liners, with an obscurity slider for hidden gems (<60k IMDb votes), 20-year mention curves, verbatim HN threads, and an open Hugging Face dataset updated weekly.

posts.name: Fedora 45
posts.tagline: A modern, open-source Linux OS for developers and creators.
posts.description: Fedora Linux 45 brings a free, community-built operating system for developers and desktop users. Explore GNOME 51, a modernized console, stricter package-signature checks, and updated tools like Podman 6, Python 3.15, and Go 1.27.

posts.name: ExamBadi
posts.tagline: Free Telugu and English exam notes, MCQs and mock tests
posts.description: ExamBadi helps students in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana prepare for competitive exams one topic at a time. Read free bilingual notes in Telugu and English across history, polity, geography, economy, science, current affairs and more, then practise chapter-wise MCQs with explanations and take timed tests. Previous AP TET and AP DSC papers come with official answer keys, explanations and a mock-test mode. Track your progress and save topics.

posts.name: Doctano: Health context for AI
posts.tagline: Lab reports into one health timeline. Ask AI, track results
posts.description: Doctano brings all your lab reports into one place. Upload PDFs or photos to build a health timeline, track biomarkers over time, and understand your results with DoctanoAI, an assistant that answers questions using your own health records. Explore results by body system, manage health records for your family, and keep everything private. All features are free, with no subscriptions or locked features.

posts.name: QAmcp Monitor
posts.tagline: Know when an AI can’t use your MCP server anymore
posts.description: QAmcp Monitor tests your MCP server the way an AI app uses it and emails you when it goes down, a tool changes, the score drops or a key shows up in an answer. Free for 1 server. Built on QAmcp, a free open-source MCP tester.

posts.name: Dino Strike
posts.tagline: The lost Flash brawler, back from the dead and playable now
posts.description: Remember Dino Strike? The forgotten arcade classic returns, rebuilt for the modern web. Jump into action, take on dangerous enemies, face returning bosses, and fight your way through the campaign without installing a Flash plugin. With multiple difficulty modes, enhanced boss encounters, a six-slot save system, and Photo Mode, this restoration brings a childhood favourite back to life while adding new ways to play. Flash may be gone, but the dinosaurs aren't.

posts.name: CaramOS
posts.tagline: A Linux distro for Vietnamese users, built on Linux Mint
posts.description: CaramOS is a Linux distribution for Vietnamese users, remastered from Linux Mint 22.3 Cinnamon (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS base). The Vietnamese language and Fcitx5 Lotus typing (Telex or VNI) are ready after install. It adds an App Center for apps like office suites, browsers and Zalo, a driver check for Wi-Fi, graphics and audio, and an update center for upgrading in place. Version 1.3.3, GPL-3.0, a 2.8 GB ISO you can try from USB before installing.

posts.name: PisteJob
posts.tagline: Job offers scored against your CV, a CV tailored to each one
posts.description: PisteJobThe smartest way to find a job, from offer to interview. PisteJob reads job offers from job boards, company career pages and the web, scores each one against your CV, then tailors your CV to the ones you pick without inventing anything. It finds who to contact and prepares you for the interview. 8 languages.

posts.name: FedoLinux
posts.tagline: Practical Fedora guides, from setup to troubleshooting
posts.description: Fedolinux is an independent, bilingual guide to Fedora Linux. Follow practical tutorials for installation, DNF5, upgrades, SELinux, Podman, server setup, and troubleshooting—with verification steps and links to upstream sources.
